english: Commands are edited separately from chat messages.
Down selects a suggestion; Up moves toward the input. Enter inserts the selected suggestion without executing it.
Read or edit the inserted command, then press Enter again to run it.
Tab completes command names. Up from the input recalls recent commands.
Delete removes a selected history entry, or resets a selected Frequent command's usage count.
Contextual ordering remembers the screen that opened command entry. Other matching commands remain available.
A question mark while typing is ordinary text. On a selected suggestion it opens this help.
Escape returns to the originating log or response.
